fields.climate: tropical; marine; rainy season during southwest monsoon (June to August); persistent and extensive cloudiness all year
fields.terrain: eastern two-thirds mostly rugged mountains; flat to gently rolling plains in west
fields.hazards: earthquakes; typhoons; volcanism: Kueishantao Island (401 m), east of Taiwan, is the only historically active volcano, but it has not erupted in centuries
fields.resources: small deposits of coal, natural gas, limestone, marble, asbestos, arable land
fields.farm: rice, vegetables, pork, chicken, cabbages, milk, sugarcane, tropical fruits, pineapples, eggs
fields.exports: integrated circuits, machine parts, broadcasting equipment, computers, plastics
fields.industries: electronics, communications and information technology products, petroleum refining, chemicals, textiles, iron and steel, machinery, cement, food processing, vehicles, consumer products…
fields.languages: Mandarin (official), Min Nan, Hakka dialects, approximately 16 indigenous languages
fields.religions: Buddhist 35.3%, Taoist 33.2%, Christian 3.9%, folk religion (includes Confucian) approximately 10%, none or unspecified 18.2%
fields.military: men 18-36 years of age may volunteer or must complete 12 months of compulsory military service; civil service can be substituted for military service in some cases; women can volunteer
